name: io.simpleswap.mcp/mcp
title: SimpleSwap
description: Crypto exchange rates, currencies, pairs, limits and prefilled exchange links from SimpleSwap

tools.name: simpleswap_list_currencies
tools.description: List cryptocurrencies supported by SimpleSwap. Filter with query (ticker, network or name) and page with offset/limit. The full list has thousands of entries and each response is cut at about 20 000 characters regardless of limit: when truncated is true, call again with offset=nextOffset, or narrow the list with query. Pass ticker and network together to get one currency with full details: address validation, extra id, explorers and warnings.

offset.description: Index of the first item to return. Default 0.

limit.description: Upper bound on items to return. The response is also cut by size, so fewer may come back: check truncated and continue with nextOffset.

query.description: Case-insensitive filter by ticker, network or name, e.g. "usdt" or "tron".

tools.name: simpleswap_list_pairs
tools.description: List the currencies a given currency can be exchanged to on SimpleSwap, for floating (default) or fixed rate. Identify the source by ticker and network (e.g. btc/btc); if the network is unknown, find it with simpleswap_list_currencies first. Use query to check one target currency. Page with offset/limit: each response is cut at about 20 000 characters regardless of limit, so when truncated is true, call again with offset=nextOffset.

fixed.description: true for fixed-rate, false for floating-rate (default).

query.description: Case-insensitive filter of the targets by ticker or network, e.g. "usdt" or "trx".

offset.description: Index of the first item to return. Default 0.

limit.description: Upper bound on items to return. The response is also cut by size, so fewer may come back: check truncated and continue with nextOffset.

tools.name: simpleswap_get_range
tools.description: Get the minimum and maximum amount SimpleSwap accepts for a currency pair. Amounts are in the currency the user sends, or in the currency the user receives when reverse is true. reverse works only with fixed: true; never combine it with a floating rate. The range differs between fixed-rate and floating-rate exchanges. An absent min or max means there is no limit on that side. Call this before suggesting or estimating an amount and never propose an amount outside the range. The range changes over time: request it again instead of reusing an old one.

fixed.description: true for fixed-rate, false for floating-rate (default).

tickerFrom.description: Ticker of the currency the user sends, e.g. "btc".

networkFrom.description: Network of the currency the user sends, e.g. "btc".

tickerTo.description: Ticker of the currency the user receives, e.g. "eth".

networkTo.description: Network of the currency the user receives, e.g. "eth".

reverse.description: true to treat amount as the amount the user receives instead of sends. Only with fixed: true; floating-rate requests must keep reverse false.

tools.name: simpleswap_get_estimate
tools.description: Estimate how much the user receives for an amount (or, with reverse, how much to send). reverse works only with fixed: true. Check the allowed amounts with simpleswap_get_range first. Fixed-rate estimates include rateId and validUntil.

fixed.description: true for fixed-rate, false for floating-rate (default).

tickerFrom.description: Ticker of the currency the user sends, e.g. "btc".

networkFrom.description: Network of the currency the user sends, e.g. "btc".

tickerTo.description: Ticker of the currency the user receives, e.g. "eth".

networkTo.description: Network of the currency the user receives, e.g. "eth".

reverse.description: true to treat amount as the amount the user receives instead of sends. Only with fixed: true; floating-rate requests must keep reverse false.

amount.description: Amount to exchange as a positive decimal, e.g. "0.2".

tools.name: simpleswap_prepare_exchange
tools.description: Prepare an exchange for the user to finish on simpleswap.io: check the parameters and get a link to the SimpleSwap exchange form with the pair, networks, amount and rate type filled in. Safe to call: it creates no exchange, reserves no rate and has no side effects. When canCreate is true, show exchangeFormUrl to the user: they enter and confirm the receiving address on the site. amount is always the amount the user sends; to start from the amount the user receives, get the amount to send with simpleswap_get_estimate first. The rate and availability can change before the user opens the link. When canCreate is false there is no link, and reason explains why: tell the user.

fixed.description: true for fixed-rate, false for floating-rate (default).

tickerFrom.description: Ticker of the currency the user sends, e.g. "btc".

networkFrom.description: Network of the currency the user sends, e.g. "btc".

tickerTo.description: Ticker of the currency the user receives, e.g. "eth".

networkTo.description: Network of the currency the user receives, e.g. "eth".

amount.description: Amount the user sends as a positive decimal, e.g. "0.2".
